To counter Tate & Liza's Psychic-type double battle, catch Sharpedo for immediate Dark-type damage and Shuppet (Banette) for massive Ghost-type physical strikes, while leveling your underleveled party [1].

### Top picks

#### Sharpedo (core)
* **Where:** Route 103, 118, or 122 (Super Rod, Lv 30-35, 40% encounter rate) [2]
* **When:** Before the Mossdeep Gym [1]
* **Why it helps now:** Its Dark typing makes it completely immune to Tate & Liza's Psychic attacks [1]. In Gen III, Dark moves are Special, so it can deal massive damage to their team using Crunch or Bite [1].
* **Long run:** An outstanding offensive pick for Phoebe in the Elite Four, though its fragile defenses require careful positioning [1].
* **Backup:** Trapinch (Mirage Tower or Route 111 desert) [3]. It evolves into Flygon, whose Ground/Dragon typing and Levitate provide immunity to Claydol's Earthquake and utility for Drake [1].

#### Shuppet (core)
* **Where:** Mt. Pyre 1F-3F (Walk, Lv 22-29, 100% encounter rate) [4]
* **When:** Before the Mossdeep Gym [1]
* **Why it helps now:** Evolves into Banette at Lv37 [5]. Ghost-type moves are physical in Gen III, allowing Banette to unleash massive STAB damage with its 115 base Attack against their Psychic-types [1].
* **Long run:** Superb for sweeping Phoebe's Ghost-types in the Elite Four, though its low speed and defenses require support [1].
* **Backup:** Spheal (Shoal Cave) [6]. It provides Ice-type attacks to hit Xatu and Claydol effectively, and evolves into Walrein to tank hits [1].

---

### Key Battle Notes

* **Gym Leader Tate & Liza:** They use Claydol (Lv41), Xatu (Lv41), Lunatone (Lv42), and Solrock (Lv42) in a double battle [7][8]. Every opponent carries Psychic, which heavily threatens Breloom [7][8][9]. Additionally, Claydol has Earthquake (threatening Manectric) and Solrock has Solar Beam (threatening your Marshtomp) [7][8][9].

---

### Rules I followed
* None active (normal run).

### Assumptions
* Your party needs severe grinding, as Marshtomp is currently only Lv33 and the gym's peak is Lv42 [10].
* Marshtomp should be evolved into Swampert at Lv36 before the battle to improve its bulk [10].

### To sharpen this
* Do you have access to the Super Rod to catch Sharpedo [1]?
* Are you willing to spend TM30 Shadow Ball on Banette [1]?
